pattern_brief: Tesla had the biggest single post today and AI had the most volume. Tesla side: JoeTegtmeyer's own Giga Texas footage of logo'd Cybercabs is the post of the day at 236.7k, followed by Trick or Treat Mode (93.3k), DirtyTesLa's 'self driving cars at home' clip (84k) and the used-Teslas-over-sticker post (59.3k). What works: a one-line cold open with a named thing (a car, a model, a mode), owned footage or a personal story, and a short stat stack or list. The surprise is that first-person use beat a lot of pure news again. For Jose: you posted nothing in the window, so the easy win today is one post before 3 PM PT. The best fits are a Trick or Treat Mode clip from your own driveway this weekend, or a 9-year ex-Tesla take on the FSD unsupervised-miles curve with your own monthly numbers.
